info.title: Public Space Mock Register
info.description: Mock register of objects in public space (openbare ruimte): trees, street lights, play equipment, market pitches and road sections. Example data a case can link an object to; the Zuiddrecht example set imports it and fills it.

x-openregister.description: Public space mock register for development and demos, so a case can link a real object with a status of its own

public-space.title: Openbare ruimte
public-space.description: Objects in public space that the municipality manages and that cases are about: trees, street lights, play equipment, market pitches and road sections.

tree.title: Bomenregister
tree.summary: A tree the municipality manages in public space.
tree.description: A tree the municipality manages in public space.

identification.title: Identification
identification.description: The tree number on its tag, such as BM-0412.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name a reader knows the object by.

status.title: Status
status.description: The tree's condition as the last inspection found it.

plantingYear.title: Planting year
plantingYear.description: The year the tree was planted.

heightClass.title: Height class
heightClass.description: Height class in metres, such as 15-18 m.

trunkDiameter.title: Trunk diameter
trunkDiameter.description: Diameter at chest height, in centimetres.

monumental.title: Monumental
monumental.description: Whether the tree is on the municipal list of monumental trees.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the object is, as a GeoJSON point in WGS84.
